hook: 4 things men say instead of "I'm afraid."
"I'll do better" is not a standard.
The third exception slips by you.
3 things people learn when your standards bend
You don't have standards. You have preferences.
Strong men get corrected on purpose.
They quietly stopped counting on you.
3 things that happen to men who ignore power
Leverage is having somewhere else to go.
You don't lose respect arguing. You lose it rushing.
You lost the room before you spoke.
3 ways men lose respect they took years to build
You're not too nice. You're being used.
"A real man would..." is a leash.
Real deals survive a night's sleep.
Your most fun friend is your biggest leak.
3 things bad company takes before you notice.
Your bank app is a lie detector.
You don't have an income problem.
Uncounted risk is just a bet.
3 things spending it all costs you.
A goal without a plan is a daydream.
3 things a vague purpose costs you.
